title: Wrists and hands
intro: Small, kind moves for the hands that do so much typing. Keep everything light and easy.

moves.name: Open and close
steps: Rest your hands in front of you.
Spread your fingers wide, then softly make loose fists.

moves.name: Wrist circles
steps: Let your forearms rest on your lap or the desk.
Draw slow circles with your hands.

moves.name: Finger spread
steps: Press your fingertips lightly together in front of you.
Spread your fingers apart, then bring them back together.

moves.name: Gentle wrist bend
steps: Hold one arm out with the palm facing down.
With the other hand, softly guide the fingers toward the floor.
Ease off at the first sign of tightness, then switch hands.

moves.name: Shake it out
steps: Shake them lightly, like drying them without a towel.

moves.name: Thumb circles
steps: Make a loose fist with your thumb resting outside.
Draw small slow circles with your thumb.

closing: That is the set. Your hands can go back to work whenever you are ready.
wayOut: Stop if anything feels uncomfortable, and skip any move that does not suit you.
